blocks.text:
○ Oral communication is different from written
communication
\t• Keep it simple and focus on a few key points
\t• Repeat key insights
○ Be sensitive to your audience
\t• The same talk may need to be adjusted for a different
  audience
○ Make the audience want to learn more
○ Handling Q&A is as important as the formal talk
itself
